summary: Nomura Holdings filed a Form 6-K with an exhibit containing its financial summary for the three months ended June 30, 2026. The filing notes completion of the interim review by CPAs, with no changes from the previously disclosed quarterly results. Operating results show net income attributable to shareholders of ¥145,561 million, up 39.2% year-over-year. Total NHI shareholders' equity per share was ¥1,311.94 at quarter-end. The filing also provides dividend information and earnings forecasts. This is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event.
